Package io.github.brantunger.unruly.api

Class LoggingRuleListener

java.lang.Object
io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.LoggingRuleListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
RuleListener
public class LoggingRuleListener extends Object implements RuleListener
An out-of-the-box RuleListener that logs lifecycle events via SLF4J at the DEBUG level. Useful for auditing or tracing which rules evaluate to true and when their actions execute.

    • onError

      public void onError(Rule rule, RuleExecutionException error)
      Description copied from interface: RuleListener
      Called when evaluating a rule's condition or executing its action fails, in place of RuleListener.afterEvaluate(io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.Rule, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.Object>, boolean) or RuleListener.afterExecute(io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.Rule, java.lang.Object). Every before* callback is followed by exactly one call to the matching after* method or to this method, so resources opened in before* (timers, tracing spans, logging context) can always be closed.

      error is the exception that run() throws once all listeners have been notified. This includes a condition or action that throws an Error: a StackOverflowError or AssertionError is wrapped in error. For any other Error, such as an OutOfMemoryError, error wraps it and run() rethrows the original error instead. Errors found while compiling rules in setRuleList() are not reported here.

      Specified by:
      onError in interface RuleListener
      Parameters:
      rule - The rule whose condition or action failed.
      error - The exception about to be thrown from run().
